title: Read an array item
summary: Solidity: Read an array item. Read scores[0] instead.
introduction: A memory array is temporary data for the call. Call answer() to read its second item.
learningObjectives: Read an array item with Solidity

blocks.text: Paste one contract into Remix and choose compiler 0.8.24 or later in the 0.8 series. Deploy only to Remix VM for practice. Call the function named in the lesson; shown results are return values.

blocks.title: Read an array item

blocks.text: The memory array has two positions. Position 1 is filled with 8 and then returned.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: An index outside the array reverts the call.
